paragraphs: The XE P200 uses the Ingenium AJ200 — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine fitted across the X760 generation from 2020 onwards. It's part of Jaguar's current-era petrol range and sits alongside the P250 and P300 as the entry-level petrol option in the XE lineup. Unlike the earlier diesel variants, the P200's engine code isn't an evolution of a Ford-era unit — it's part of Jaguar's own Ingenium family, designed and built in-house from the ground up.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ200 engines for every XE P200 on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine fitted to the XE P200 from 2020 onwards (X760 generation). This is Jaguar's own Ingenium design, not a carryover from the earlier Ford EcoBoost era. We replace timing chain components, bearings and gaskets as standard during every AJ200 rebuild.
